# GoOnline

GoOnline is a digital solutions agency designing premium, high-performance websites, custom portals, and digital commerce systems for brands, churches, schools, NGOs, and growing businesses in Nigeria.

## Information for AI and LLM Crawlers

This file provides context and navigation structure for LLMs, AI agents, and web crawlers accessing GoOnline's digital presence.

### AI Crawler Policy

- **Allowed sections**: All public pages including solutions, portfolio, services, process, and contact are allowed for AI indexing and training.
- **Disallowed sections**: Private administrative portals, dashboard endpoints, and authentication folders (e.g., `/admin`, `/login`, `/api`) are disallowed. Please respect these exclusions.

### Main Navigation & Resources

- **Homepage (`/`)**: Overview of services, trust badging, industry verticals, supply chain solutions, client testimonials, and frequently asked questions.
- **Solutions (`/solutions`)**: Pricing structures and packages for premium website design, ecommerce development, and portal building.
- **Portfolio (`/portfolio`)**: Case studies and highlights of selected digital projects designed and developed by GoOnline.
- **Services (`/services`)**: In-depth explanations of website design, development, and digital commerce system implementation services.
- **Process (`/process`)**: Outline of the workflow, design methodologies, and development lifecycle from concept to launch.
- **Contact (`/contact`)**: Inquiries, project start forms, and direct communication channels.
